source_reasoning: sendRequest line 513 invokes executeProcedures. An injected IOException at this door is pre-send and bypasses that invocation.
ExecuteProceduresRemoteCall.run lines 471-487 catches IOException and calls scheduleForRetry.

scheduleForRetry lines 295-371 retries a plain IOException while its RegionServer remains online: it is neither DoNotRetryIOException nor the specifically recognized pre-connect errors, increments attempts, then calls submitTask(this, delay, MILLISECONDS).

RemoteProcedureDispatcher.submitTask(Runnable,long,TimeUnit) lines 212-213 enqueues a DelayedTask; its TimeoutExecutorThread later submits that task to the dispatcher pool. A retry can therefore send a new ExecuteProcedures request and reach a later guard check.
